title: Building Helm's Initial Feature Backlog
learning_objectives: Translate the Helm product spec into well-structured GitHub Issues
Prioritize issues by MVP scope, labeling appropriately
Assign all MVP issues to the v1 milestone
Have a working Kanban board ready to drive Phase 2 development
outline: Review: Helm product spec and MVP success criteria
Breaking the spec into issues: one issue per user-facing feature or infrastructure piece
Writing issues for each MVP component: task list, time-blocking calendar, Google Calendar sync, PWA install
Prioritizing: P1 (MVP required) vs. P2 (nice to have) labels
Populating the board: all MVP issues in Backlog, assigned to MVP v1 milestone
Review and refine: is the backlog complete enough to start building?

helm_context.deliverable: 10-15 well-structured issues in GitHub, labeled and assigned to MVP v1 milestone, visible on the Kanban board

criteria: At least 10 issues created covering all Helm MVP features
Each issue follows the quality standards from L02 (clear title, body, acceptance criteria)
All MVP issues labeled P1 and assigned to MVP v1 milestone
Board is populated and visually represents the full MVP scope
Learner can walk through the board and explain each issue's purpose

professor_constraints: Reference the Helm product spec directly — this is the source of truth for what to build
Coach the learner through decomposition: 'the drag-to-time-block feature probably needs 3 issues, not 1'
The goal is a backlog good enough to start building in Phase 2, not perfect
Celebrate P01 completion — this marks the transition from setup to actual development
